question: Under what condition can one whose mind is fixed on that remain uncut even when being cut?
premises: Cutting is directed at one who is being cut.
A mind fixed on that differs from a mind fixed elsewhere.
The effect of cutting fails to reach one so oriented.
inference: One whose mind is fixed on that is not severed by the act of cutting.
uncertainties: Extent to which orientation of mind blocks the cutting effect remains unspecified.
plain_english: As one whose mind is fixed on that is being cut, one is not cut.
